os/run#

Run a tool and read what it printed (#197):

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let status = await Run("git", ["status", "--short"]).text();
let done = await Run("make", ["test"]).completion();  // any exit code

Description#

Run a tool and read what it printed (#197):

The program is looked up on PATH and runs with the environment and working directory of this process; no shell parses the name or the arguments. Standard output and standard error are each kept up to 1 MiB, more is CaptureLimitExceeded. text() and bytes() want a zero exit code: any other end is CommandFailed with what the program wrote to standard error. CommandCapture over a Command sets another environment, directory, input or limit.

Public API#

object Run#

object Run

Runs a program found in PATH with the process's environment, and gives what it printed.

Run.Run#

Run(program is string, arguments is @string = [])

Runs program with arguments; nothing runs until text(), bytes() or completion() is asked.

Run.text#

async text() is string

Standard output as UTF-8 text, after a zero exit code.

Run.bytes#

async bytes() is @byte

The exact bytes of standard output, after a zero exit code.

Run.completion#

async completion() is CompletedCommand

The completed command whatever its exit code: done.exit().success().

enum CommandFailed#

A run that did not end with exit code zero: the code, or how it was stopped, and what it wrote to standard error.
